page.layout: One block of running text in the upper part, with a short italic verse stanza below it. Blank space below the verse. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: intemerata fide rutilat, & sospite Deo sacrosancta, invulnerata, & a blasphemijs, ac feralibus nefariorum hominum telis pudicissima, in summa rerum omnium potestate, ut aiebat ille,

p.i: Intaminatis fulget honoribus: Nec sumit aut ponit secures Arbitrio popularis auræ.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side is faintly visible in the blank lower half and is omitted. The printed long s in "sospite" and "secures" is transcribed as plain s. The stanza is set in italic type. No page number or running head is printed.
